# Catalog lifecycle classification

Closes **CAT-000-003** — every provider / product / capability / direction / region / version in `docs/architecture/cat-integration-inventory.md`, classified with the exact sixteen-state lifecycle printed in §6 of `Tenure_Global_Deployer_Integration_Catalog_and_Tenant_Connection_Composer_Claude_Bible_v1.0.md`. The state column is DERIVED from each row's own declaration by the rules below; it is not typed in.

## The §6 vocabulary (16 states, read from the Bible)

`INVENTORY_ONLY` · `ROADMAP_CANDIDATE` · `PLANNED` · `SPECIFIED` · `IN_DEVELOPMENT` · `SANDBOX_VALIDATED` · `PROVIDER_REVIEW_PENDING` · `TENURE_CERTIFIED` · `TENANT_ELIGIBLE` · `TENANT_CONNECTED` · `TENANT_ACTIVE` · `DEGRADED` · `SUSPENDED` · `DEPRECATED` · `REVOKED` · `UNSUPPORTED`

## Derivation rules

| Rule | Reads | §6 state |
| --- | --- | --- |
| R1 | capability status PLANNED (or a pack that declared none, which `pack()` defaults to PLANNED) | `PLANNED` |
| R2 | capability status DEVELOPMENT | `IN_DEVELOPMENT` |
| R3 | capability status CERTIFICATION_PENDING and the provider review is NOT_SUBMITTED — code exists, nobody has approached the provider | `IN_DEVELOPMENT` |
| R4 | capability status CERTIFICATION_PENDING and a provider review has been submitted | `PROVIDER_REVIEW_PENDING` |
| R5 | capability status UNSUPPORTED, or a payments leaf built by `unsupported()` | `UNSUPPORTED` |
| R6 | a model-catalog row, which carries no capability status: it is an allowlist entry for the connector that invokes it and inherits that connector's state | `IN_DEVELOPMENT` |

No rule can produce a state above `IN_DEVELOPMENT`. `SANDBOX_VALIDATED`, `PROVIDER_REVIEW_PENDING`, `TENURE_CERTIFIED`, `TENANT_ELIGIBLE` and everything after them assert a sandbox run, a provider submission or a certification, and this tree records none — `RELAY_ANTHROPIC_REVIEW.state` is `NOT_SUBMITTED`. A rule that emitted one anyway would be a fabricated approval.
